producers.displayName: OpenDrSai IDE Context for JetBrains IDEs
packagePreflight: Copy plugin.xml into a JetBrains Platform plugin project.
Build the plugin ZIP with the JetBrains Gradle plugin.
Install the ZIP from disk in a JetBrains IDE and restart the IDE.
manualValidation: Open a project folder that matches the Windows desktop workspace.
Open a source file, select text, and switch editor focus or move the caret.
Confirm .drsai/ide-context.json contains source: "jetbrains", currentFile, and currentSelection.
Refresh IDE context in the desktop chat composer and attach IDE current file or IDE selection.

producers.displayName: OpenDrSai IDE Context for Visual Studio
packagePreflight: Create a Visual Studio 2022 VSIX project.
Copy source.extension.vsixmanifest and source/OpenDrSaiIdeContextPackage.cs into the project.
Install or debug the VSIX in an experimental Visual Studio instance.
manualValidation: Open a solution folder that matches the Windows desktop workspace.
Open a source file, select text, and invoke the package capture command.
Confirm .drsai/ide-context.json contains source: "visual_studio", currentFile, and currentSelection.
Refresh IDE context in the desktop chat composer and attach IDE current file or IDE selection.
